nodes.title: Vine and Cellar Fundamentals
nodes.description: Vines, press and barrel. Opens every other vintner skill.

nodes.title: Cellar Craft
nodes.description: Press, ferment and bottle table wine properly. Unlocks the tavern wine contract.

nodes.title: Estate Vintages
nodes.description: Aged and blended wines for the estates. Unlocks the estate cellar contract.

nodes.title: Cellar Logistics
nodes.description: Buy in bulk: 5% off goods at the regional exchange.

nodes.title: Home Distilling
nodes.description: Brew strong spirit off the books. The craft is the same one a licensed distiller learns.

nodes.title: Distiller's Licence
nodes.description: A distiller's licence. Where a city issues permits, spirits are legal for you to carry and to sell to licensed bars.

nodes.title: Concealed Stores
nodes.description: Bottles behind false staves in an honest barrel: 12 points off the chance that a checkpoint search finds anything.

nodes.title: Bootleg Trade
nodes.description: Open a line to an Ironhaven back bar. Unlocks quiet bottle delivery contracts.

nodes.title: Grey Market Contacts
nodes.description: A trusted landlord takes bigger loads. Unlocks the reserve run (needs trust 2).
